entries.note: The order's first event in CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru. English: Accepted. Processing...
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru.
Shown in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru for a marketplace parcel. English: Order created.
An order event: the pickup courier is on the way to the sender. English: Courier is already on the way.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. A pickup courier was sent.
An order event. English: Waybill issued based on the order.
Listed in CSE's extended API documentation (lk.cse.ru/files/uploads/extended_api_2020_05_06_EngVer.pdf).
The waybill's first event; its place is the office that registered it. English: Shipment created.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru.

entries.wording: Накладная сохранена, но ещё не была обработана
entries.note: The status of a waybill without events in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru. English: The waybill was saved but not processed yet.
An order event; its info names the courier. English: Shipment picked up.
An order event; its info names the courier. English: Shipment received by the courier.
Listed in CSE's extended API documentation (lk.cse.ru/files/uploads/extended_api_2020_05_06_EngVer.pdf), and shown in an archived reply of its tracking API.

entries.wording: Заказ принят на складе службы доставки
entries.note: Shown in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru: a marketplace parcel's first arrival at CSE's warehouse.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru and of its tracking API. Received at a CSE warehouse.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru and of its tracking API.
Shown in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru. The shipment left the warehouse.
English: Shipment is on the way.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. Arrived in the destination city.
Shown in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru. Arrived in the destination city.
A parcel from China at the origin warehouse; the reply puts Moscow as its place. English: Shipment arrived at the warehouse (China).
A parcel from China on its way to Russia; the reply puts Moscow as its place. English: Cargo in transit China-Russia.
Taken back from the pickup point to CSE's office. English: The cargo has left the pickup point.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. The delivery was redirected, an instruction that moves nothing.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. The delivery was postponed at the customer's request, an instruction rather than a problem.
English: Cargo handed over for delivery.
Its info names the delivering courier. English: Await the courier today.

entries.wording: Информация по отправлению. Получатель/ компания на адресе не найдены
entries.note: "Информация по отправлению" with the reason its info gives: the recipient or company was not found at the address. The info adds what went wrong, such as a phone that did not answer.

entries.wording: Информация по отправлению. Уточнение данных по накладной (доставке) клиентом
entries.note: The customer added details to the waybill or its delivery; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Информация по отправлению. Переадресация через виджет
entries.note: The customer changed the delivery through CSE's widget; it moves nothing.
Shown in an archived reply of CSE's tracking API at lk.cse.ru; its info gives the new delivery address. The order's details were changed, which moves nothing.
The event carries the pickup point's address, hours and phones. English: Awaiting at the pickup point.

entries.wording: Получатель самостоятельно заберет отправку из офиса КС.
entries.note: Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. The recipient will collect the item at a CSE office.
English: Delivery completed.
Shown on archived replies of CSE's Cargo 3 tracking portal at cse-cargo.ru. The portal follows it with the recipient's name.
Listed in CSE's extended API documentation (lk.cse.ru/files/uploads/extended_api_2020_05_06_EngVer.pdf).

"Оформлена добавочная накладная" (supplementary waybill issued) with the reason its info gives: a return waybill for the cargo, issued after the delivery run. The page nests the return waybill's own history under it.
